params.name: W
params.comment: cabinet width, X (front panel to aft panel, outside)

params.name: D
params.comment: cabinet depth, Y (side panel to side panel, outside)

params.name: H
params.comment: cabinet height to the top surface, Z

params.name: t
params.comment: ply thickness. Onshape value (nominal 3/4); MEASURE the sheet before cutting

params.name: kennel_h
params.comment: kennel opening height = underside of the shelf

params.name: fill_w
params.comment: fixed top filler strip along the front panel

params.name: leg_w
params.comment: side rail drop-leg width (X)

params.name: pin_d
params.comment: steel dowel pin diameter (3/8). UNVERIFIED: measure the pins you buy

params.name: pin_x
params.comment: pin centre from the front end of the rail. pin_x + groove_edge must equal fill_w or the lid hits the aft panel on the way down

params.name: pin_z
params.comment: upper pin centre below the top surface

params.name: pin_pitch
params.comment: lower pin below the upper pin (v1: 1.5 in). Doubling it halves the pin forces in desk mode

params.name: leg_h
params.comment: side rail drop-leg height from the top surface

params.name: groove_edge
params.comment: drop slot centre from the aft edge (fixed by the lid clearance, see pin_x)

params.name: desk_drop
params.comment: how far the lid drops to its lowest desk height (as v1: desk surface at H - desk_drop)

params.name: hang_drop
params.comment: upper pin drop to the hang pivot. 0 = hangs from the end of the slide (highest); the curve then runs from the lower track to the upper track and cuts an insert loose from the plate

params.name: plate_t
params.comment: aluminium track plate (SendCutSend 6061-T6 0.190), let in flush. UNVERIFIED: measure the plates

params.name: slot_w
params.comment: slot in the plate: pin + 0.15 mm running clearance

params.name: relief_w
params.comment: relief groove in the ply behind the slots (pin never bears on ply)

params.name: relief_d
params.comment: relief groove depth below the plate

params.name: band_margin
params.comment: plate below the lower track

params.name: drop_front
params.comment: plate in front of the drop slot centre

params.name: plate_r
params.comment: plate corner radius inside the panel (>= bit radius)

params.name: scr_d
params.comment: #6 flat-head screw hole (SendCutSend countersink pilot)

params.name: scr_cs
params.comment: #6 countersink diameter, 82 deg (SendCutSend)

params.name: corner_r
params.comment: inside corner radius of the rail

params.name: desk
params.comment: 0 = lid stowed on top, 1 = desk mode at its lowest height (slid out and dropped)

params.name: fold
params.comment: 0 = flat, 1 = swung down 90 deg and hanging high on the aft face (needs desk = 1)

params.name: lid_dx
params.comment: lid slide (follows desk)

params.name: lid_dz
params.comment: lid drop (follows desk and fold)

center: H - pin_z - pin_pitch - band_margin - (desk_drop + 1 in - band_margin)/2
params.name: PlateDrop
